faq.q: What is the deposit for a Marbella yacht charter in 2052?
faq.a: For 2052 bookings, the deposit is 30% of the total charter cost, payable at the time of booking. The remaining 70% is due 72 hours before departure. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) the deposit is calculated on the 8-hour rate if you book hourly. Deposits are fully refundable under the terms below.

faq.q: Can I cancel my Marbella yacht charter and get a full refund?
faq.a: Yes, if you cancel at least 14 days before the charter start date, you receive a full refund minus a €150 administrative fee. For cancellations between 7 and 13 days, you get a 50% refund. Cancellations within 6 days are non-refundable, but we offer a credit note valid for 12 months.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on my charter day?
faq.a: If we cancel the charter due to unsafe weather conditions (e.g., storms, high winds) from Puerto Banús, you get a full refund or can reschedule to another date at no extra cost. We monitor forecasts closely and will contact you at least 24 hours in advance whenever possible.

faq.q: Can I reschedule my yacht charter instead of cancelling?
faq.a: Absolutely. Rescheduling is free if you change your date at least 14 days before the original charter. Between 7 and 13 days, a €150 rescheduling fee applies. Within 6 days, rescheduling is not allowed; however, the credit note option may help.

faq.q: Are there any cancellation fees for Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80?

data.body_html:
Planning a yacht charter in Marbella for 2052? Understanding the cancellation policy is key to booking with confidence. Our policy is straightforward: free rescheduling up to 14 days, full refunds (minus a small admin fee) if you cancel early, and clear rules for last-minute changes. Here’s everything you need to know before you set sail from Puerto Banús.

Our 2052 Cancellation Policy at a Glance

We’ve designed our policy to be fair and transparent. No hidden fees, no fine print surprises. Below is the full breakdown:

Timing of cancellationRefund amountNotes
14+ days before charterFull refund minus €150 admin feeReschedule free
7–13 days before charter50% refundReschedule with €150 fee
0–6 days before charterNo refundCredit note (12 months) offered
No-showNo refundCredit note not offered

All cancellations must be confirmed in writing via email or WhatsApp. The policy applies to all boats in our fleet, from the Azimut 39 to the Mangusta 80.

Deposits and Payment Schedule

For 2052, we require a 30% deposit to secure your booking. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), the deposit is based on the total 8-hour rate (€2,299) if you book a full day. For Tier B (Mangusta 80), the deposit is 50% of the €4,719 minimum. The balance is due 72 hours before departure. If you cancel after paying the balance, the refund rules above apply.

Weather and Force Majeure

Marbella enjoys 320 sunny days a year, but the Mediterranean can be unpredictable. If we cancel your charter due to unsafe conditions (e.g., winds above 25 knots, thunderstorms), you get a full refund or free rescheduling. This is our risk, not yours. We’ll inform you at least 24 hours in advance whenever possible.

Rescheduling Your Charter

Life happens. If you need to move your charter to a later date in 2052, you can do so free of charge up to 14 days before. Between 7 and 13 days, a €150 fee applies. Within 6 days, rescheduling isn’t possible—but you can use the credit note for a future booking. Rescheduling is subject to availability, so early notice is best.

Special Cases: Illness, Emergencies, and More

We’re human, and we understand that unforeseen events occur. If you provide documentation (e.g., medical certificate) within 7 days of cancellation, we may offer a full refund or credit at our discretion. This is not a guarantee, but we aim to be flexible. For group bookings of 10+ guests, please contact us directly for tailored terms.

What’s Included in Every Charter

When you book with us, you get more than just a boat. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and safety equipment. Spanish IVA (21%) is always included in the price. This applies to all boats, from the Dubhe (8m) to the Ferretti 94 (29m).

How to Cancel or Reschedule

To cancel or reschedule, email us at hello@boatrentalmarbella.com with your booking reference. For last-minute changes (within 48 hours), WhatsApp is fastest. We’ll confirm within 24 hours. Remember: all changes must be in writing to be valid.

Compare Our Fleet Before You Book

Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella’s luxury scene. Whether you want a fast Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) or a spacious Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax), we have options. Check our full fleet overview to see which boat suits your group. For a relaxed day, the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) at €749 for 2 hours is a great choice.
